description: a_2KyXfzZvm was fixed on an inference rather than a transcript, and the fix is right only if the inference is. Recorded: a fresh subscription replays every arrangement a tab has outgrown, and layout_updated carries a zoomed flag taking both values. Inferred: a tab zoomed after its last split replays unzoomed-then-zoomed and both pass arranges. No transcript shows a replayed zoom, because the probe scenario never zooms. Teach the layout-replay probe to zoom and re-record both platforms; it needs --corpus-linux, and a one-sided re-record breaks that workflow. Related: a_29qxvebDg.
title: The layout-replay probe never zooms, so the replayed zoom is inferred
